*TL:DR - Are quality builds actually viable? Do I just need to Git Gud?*

I have run through the game about three times on the same character, using different builds each time I go. I've done a Strength build, a Dex build, a Sorcery build, a Miracle build, and right now, a Quality build. Out of all of the builds, Strength always seems the most effective. Sorcery seemed decent in PvE but garbage in PvP, where as Dex was the opposite, good in PvP not so good in PvE. Miracles were alright on both fronts, though it seemed like that was just because of buffs and AoE miracles like Wrath of the Gods or Lightning Storm. And Strength was, of course, the best fairing, doing very well in PvP and PvE. Due to all of the previous experiences with all the other runs, and since I hear quite a bit about Quality being the best for PvP, I decided to try it out. Immediately, I noticed that it was mediocre halfway point between being good and being trash, and failed to see how it was any better than anything else I had previously tried. The only benefit I saw was being able to use most weapons with 45 STR and 40 DEX. The weapons that I currently use are a +10 Refined Darksword because R1 spam, and it has B STR and B DEX scaling, the best I've seen, and because I had heard that it was pretty good I also have a +10 Refined Lothric Knight Sword, which I believe has C C scaling. While they do decent damage and buffing them with fire resin allows for huge stun lock potential, I still don't see the benefit. Is there a better way to go about it? Am I using the wrong weapons?
